# Rental Ledger: Schedule E, depreciation and rent roll for small landlords

> Free private rental property ledger: log rent and expenses per property, get Schedule E by property, 27.5-year depreciation, the $25,000 passive loss allowance, a monthly rent collection grid and the 1099-NEC list. No account, no bank link, nothing uploaded.

Free and open source (MIT). Results are estimates from the numbers typed in, not legal, tax, financial or professional advice.
